definitions.explanation: A spoken account of events or a narrative.
An exchange of ideas through speech.

examples.japanese: {面白|おもしろ}い{話|はなし}を{聞|き}いた。

examples.english: I have something to talk about.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}を{聞|き}いてください。
examples.english: Please listen to what I have to say.
It will be a long story.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}が{分|わ}かりやすい。
examples.english: The story is easy to understand.

examples.japanese: {昔話|むかしばなし}を{読|よ}んであげた。
examples.english: I read them an old tale.

examples.japanese: これは{本当|ほんとう}の{話|はなし}です。
{友達|ともだち}と{楽|たの}しく{話|はなし}をした。
examples.english: I had a fun conversation with my friend.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}とは{話|はなし}が{合|あ}う。
examples.english: I get along well in conversation with him.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}、{大事|だいじ}な{話|はなし}をしています。
examples.english: We're having an important conversation now.

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}で{話|はなし}をしていた。
examples.english: I was having a conversation on the phone.

examples.japanese: その{話|はなし}は{聞|き}いたことがある。
{話|はなし}が{変|か}わりますが...
その{話|はなし}は{後|あと}にしましょう。
{話|はなし}を{元|もと}に{戻|もど}しましょう。
examples.english: Let's get back to the topic.

notes:
{話|はなし} is an extremely common noun with three main meanings: story/tale, conversation, and topic/matter.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {話|はなし}をする: to have a conversation
- {話|はなし}を{聞|き}く: to listen to a story/what someone says
- {話|はなし}がある: I have something to discuss
- {話|はなし}が{長|なが}い: long-winded

USEFUL EXPRESSIONS:
- {話|はなし}が{上手|じょうず}: good at talking
- {話|はなし}が{合|あ}う: to get along well in conversation
- {話|はなし}が{変|か}わる: to change the subject
- {話|はなし}にならない: out of the question, absurd

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {昔話|むかしばなし}: old tale, folklore
- {世間話|せけんばなし}: small talk, chitchat
- {身|み}の{上|うえ}{話|ばなし}: one's life story
